coordinate_convention: metres; +X east, +Y up, +Z south; same frame in Godot (no axis conversion)

terrain_height.rule: web/src/world/terrain.js height(x,z) incl. building sinks; baseHeight(x,z) without; terrainCollider() skips cells with a corner sunk > 0.8 m (floors take over)

ground.source: weathering.js W.tGround: world rect x0,z0,size; R = ground height

trodden.source: weathering.js W.tMask: world rect x0,z0,size; R = trodden path
